commands.name: getCameraMotion
commands.payload: {requestId?:number}; 0/current by default, last 32 terminal requests retained

commands.name: cancelCameraMotion
commands.payload: {requestId?:number}; stops only that request; stale cancellation cannot stop a newer flight

commands.name: navigateCamera
commands.payload: {focus:number,closeup?:boolean,yaw?:number,pitch?:number,zoom?:number,durationMs?:0..3000}; explicit continuous flight, request ID in cameraMotion

commands.name: getGalaxyObservation
commands.payload: {} - coherent recorded galaxy samples, applied parameters and selected curve; time Myr

commands.name: getGalaxyReference
commands.payload: {} - locally retained galaxy result with applied parameters and original samples

commands.name: getGalaxyComparison
commands.payload: {} - shared Myr axes, parameter differences and interpolated cursor delta; no extrapolation

commands.name: getGalaxyComparisonTable
commands.payload: {} - both raw series, 19-column CSV with applied parameters; outer fractions remain 0..1

commands.name: getGalaxyTable
commands.payload: {} - CSV of every retained galaxy frame with model, initial parameters, units and model-scoped normalized errors

commands.name: getGalaxyPlacement
commands.payload: {} - active constrained initial offset preview; original history remains untouched

commands.name: setGalaxyPlacementPoint
commands.payload: {x:0..1,y:0..1} - displayed viewport point projected onto XY offset rail; X separation fixed 60 kpc, offset clamped 0..30 kpc

commands.name: getGalaxyDiagnostics
commands.payload: {} - current frame separation/radii in kpc, outer fractions and model-scoped energy error; not unbound mass

commands.name: getRingTrace
commands.payload: {particles?:boolean}; 8192 massless particles drive ring density; returns first 192 when particles=true; controlled radial impulse 0–0.35; km/km/s; speedScale 1–1.2, rateHours 0.1–4, independent 0–24 hour clock

commands.name: setSky
commands.payload: {mode?:0 clean|1 stars|2 galaxy,brightness?:0..1}; photographic galaxy / procedural stars; fixed-direction background

commands.name: setWindowOrientation
commands.payload: {orientation:auto|portrait|landscape|reverse-landscape}; main window only; auto respects system rotation lock

commands.name: getSkyInfo
commands.payload: {} - provenance and sky rendering status

commands.name: getProjectedBodies
commands.payload: {} - last presented orbital frame; normalized top-left x/y, radius in viewport-height units; ignores UI occlusion

commands.name: pickBody
commands.payload: {x:0..1,y:0..1} - viewport hit test, shared focus action; hit=-1 leaves selection unchanged

commands.name: followSphFragment
commands.payload: {particle:0..9999,sceneRevision:number} - follow the current component containing a selected material particle; no reload

commands.name: getSphFragmentFollow
commands.payload: {} - last rendered follow state, current group identity and target center in km

commands.name: getSphFragments
commands.payload: {offset?:0..10000,limit?:1..32} - selected-frame geometric material groups, SI-derived units and frame identity; not binding/reaggregation

commands.name: getSphComparison
commands.payload: {} - shared axes, parameter differences, saved SPH provenance and interpolated cursor delta

commands.name: getSphReference
commands.payload: {} - full saved SPH reference or null; independent from orbital reference

commands.name: getSphComparisonTable
commands.payload: {} - selected metric raw current/reference CSV, seconds, no interpolated rows

commands.name: getSphWindowSummary
commands.payload: {} - read-only retained-window radius/kinetic/radial statistics; no equilibrium verdict

commands.name: getSphObservation
commands.payload: {} - retained double-precision SPH curve, metric, units, extrema and frame identity; read-only

commands.name: getSphTable
commands.payload: {} - raw SPH CSV and applied source configuration; no interpolation

commands.name: getSphDiagnostics
commands.payload: {} - selected SPH frame pressure GPa, specific internal energy MJ/kg, cubed scalar damage and mass-weighted statistics; no seek

commands.name: getObservationComparison
commands.payload: {} - shared axes, overlap, interpolated difference and saved reference provenance

commands.name: getObservationReference
commands.payload: {} - complete saved local reference or null; does not seek

commands.name: getObservationTable
commands.payload: {} - CSV rows for current and saved reference; no interpolation

commands.name: getOrbitObservation
commands.payload: {} - current planet (or first planet), retained-frame distance/speed curve; read-only

commands.name: getPlacementPreview
commands.payload: {} - candidate at frozen current time, exact source revision, two-body guide; no mutation

commands.name: setViewportPlacementPoint
commands.payload: {x:0..1,y:0..1} main viewport tap/drag; exact presented plane projection; requires active placement

commands.name: setPlacementPoint
commands.payload: {x:0..1,y:0..1} in the placement plot; same handler as tap/drag

commands.name: getOrbitPreview
commands.payload: {} - initial editor vector drafts, input coordinates, XY/XZ; does not change physics

commands.name: listExperiments
commands.payload: {} - built-in theme initial conditions, observation goals and default cameras

commands.name: getVideoCapabilities
commands.payload: {} - device encoder capabilities; unavailable during video operations

commands.name: getVideoState
commands.payload: {} - recording status, elapsed wall seconds, submitted frames and local MP4 clips; uiAction video.* controls

commands.name: getUiState
commands.payload: {} - editor drafts, body edit undo/redo history, action IDs/enabled/selected, input fields

commands.name: listUiActions
commands.payload: {} - same semantic control catalog

commands.name: uiAction
commands.payload: {action:string} - invoke a catalog action through the same ArkUI handler

commands.name: getGalaxyObserver
commands.payload: {} - solar-radius analogue observer, current frame and sky orientation; illustrative horizon

commands.name: setUiValue
commands.payload: {field:string,value:string|number} - edit a catalog field; orbital inputs stay draft until orbit.apply

commands.name: setScene
commands.payload: {preset:0..6,count:200..2400,speed:0.5..10 (preset 2 allows 0; total spin = targetSpin + speed*0.003),angle:0..70,duration:1..120; galaxy preset 6: duration 50..800 Myr, speed .75..1.25 of 156.45 km/s, angle 0..70 inclination degrees, galaxyMassRatio?:.2..1, galaxyOffsetKpc?:0..30 initial transverse offset, galaxyRetrograde?:boolean, galaxyResponsive?:boolean (massive stellar response, count<=800); custom preset 5 requires orbitBodies (2..8), speed=1; optional radiusKm:1..10000000 on every body enables ideal elastic sphere contact and auto-pause; orbit preset 3/4: speed 0.75..1.25 circular-velocity factor, duration 1..10 Julian years; count/rock fields ignored; optional selfGravity:boolean (SPH only, count<=1200, defaults false); relaxationSeconds?:0|16|64 (requires selfGravity, isolated stationary pre-relaxation); targetRadiusKm:40..200,impactorRadiusKm:20..120,targetDensity:2400..3000,impactorDensity:2400..3000,targetSpin:-0.01..0.01,seed:1..1000000}

commands.name: getPreparation
commands.payload: {}; monotonic phase timings, request ID, previous worker phase and bounded history; no mutation

commands.name: seek
commands.payload: {frame:-1 or retained frame index}

commands.name: setCamera
commands.payload: {yaw:-100..100,pitch:-1.5..1.5,zoom:0.5..15,focus:-1..1 (orbit preset 4: -1..3; custom: -1..bodyCount-1),color:0..6 (galaxy 0..1; 0 original,1 speed,2 density,3 pressure,4 specific internal energy,5 damage; orbit 0..1)}

commands.name: getSurfaceInfo
commands.payload: {}; Moon source, loading state, upload count and bounded memory

commands.name: setSurfaceSeed
commands.payload: {body:1..7,surfaceSeed?:0..1000000,cloudSeed?:0..1000000}; custom planets; preserves simulation and camera; 0 = legacy

commands.name: setMaterial
commands.payload: {exposure?:-2..2 EV,ocean?:boolean,cloudShadows?:boolean}; original-color orbital surfaces only; no camera or solver reset

commands.name: setAppearance
commands.payload: {clouds?:boolean,atmosphere?:boolean,trails?:boolean,closeup?:boolean,autoSpin?:boolean,rings?:boolean} (visual settings only)

commands.name: setPanel
commands.payload: {panel:-1 close,0 parameters,1 observe,2 library}

commands.name: saveProject
commands.payload: {title:string}

commands.name: loadProject
commands.payload: {id:string}
